definition: A highly accurate instrument for measuring time.
author: William Makepeace Thackeray
quote: When that chronometer, which was surmounted by a cheerful brass group of the sacrifice of Iphigenia, tolled five in a heavy cathedral tone…
example_sentence: The ship's chronometer kept perfect time across the ocean.
